entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4620574887039870720: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 14.4506 +/- 0.0269 mas (same row, RUWE 1.14): 69.20 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 79.231, 165.930 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.2347 +/- 0.015 solar radii from Barkaoui et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-4184 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..38B/abstract). Mass 0.2109 +/- 0.029 solar masses from Barkaoui et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-4184 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..38B/abstract). Temperature 3238 +/- 48 K from Barkaoui et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4184 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,238 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffbf7c. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 3,238 K and log g 5.02 (u1 0.153, u2 0.472): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
